<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<!-- Isaiah 41:10, Lamentations 3:22-23, Colossians 3:23, Matthew 6:33, Ecclesiastes 9:10, Ecclesiastes 4:9 -->
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>EcoSonic</title>
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" sizes="64x64" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<meta name="description" content="Hear Earth's vegetation: a NASA Space Apps sonification globe with voice control and 16 languages.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..144,600;0,9..144,700;1,9..144,600&family=Outfit:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<!-- Real 3D globe -->
<script src="https://unpkg.com/globe.gl@2.46.2/dist/globe.gl.min.js"></script>
<!-- three.js, for the cloud layer and ocean glint -->
<script type="module">import * as THREE from "https://unpkg.com/three@0.179.0/build/three.module.js"; window.THREE = THREE;</script>
<style>
:root {
  --bg0: #0b4a2a; --bg1: #13703f; --bg2: #188a4d;
  --emerald: #12804a; --jade: #1fa85c; --mint: #a8f5c8; --leaf: #b8f36b; --gold: #f3d77a;
  --text: #f2fbf5; --text-soft: #e0f5e7; --text-dim: #bfe3cc;
  --glass: rgba(20, 110, 62, 0.6); --edge: rgba(200, 255, 220, 0.35);
  --shadow: 0 18px 44px rgba(0, 40, 20, 0.35); --radius: 24px; --fs: 17px;
}
* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { font-size: var(--fs); }
html, body { margin: 0; }
body {
  min-height: 100vh; font-family: "Outfit", "Noto Sans", "Segoe UI", system-ui, Arial, sans-serif;
  color: var(--text); line-height: 1.6; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; overflow-x: hidden;
  background:
    radial-gradient(60% 50% at 80% 0%, rgba(60, 200, 110, 0.35), transparent 70%),
    radial-gradient(50% 45% at 0% 100%, rgba(184, 243, 107, 0.12), transparent 70%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg2) 0%, var(--bg1) 50%, var(--bg0) 100%);
  background-attachment: fixed;
}
body::before { content: ""; position: fixed; inset: -10%; z-index: -1; pointer-events: none;
  background: radial-gradient(30% 25% at 30% 30%, rgba(124, 240, 176, 0.10), transparent 70%), radial-gradient(25% 25% at 70% 70%, rgba(15, 107, 62, 0.35), transparent 70%);
  animation: drift 30s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
@keyframes drift { to { transform: translate3d(-3%, 2%, 0) scale(1.06); } }
body.age-child { --fs: 20px; } body.age-teen { --fs: 18px; } body.age-adult { --fs: 17px; }
body.age-child p, body.age-child .pop-info { line-height: 1.85; letter-spacing: 0.01em; }
[dir="rtl"] .stage-controls, [dir="rtl"] header { direction: rtl; }
::selection { background: var(--mint); color: var(--bg0); }
a { color: var(--mint); }
button { font: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--gold); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 12px; }
.sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; }
.skip { position: absolute; left: 12px; top: -60px; z-index: 100; background: var(--gold); color: var(--bg0); padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 700; }
.skip:focus { top: 12px; }
h1, h2, h3 { font-family: "Fraunces", "Noto Serif", Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; margin: 0 0 0.4em; color: #fff; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }

/* ---------- top bar: language + voice ---------- */
.topbar { position: fixed; top: 14px; right: 16px; z-index: 50; display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
[dir="rtl"] .topbar { right: auto; left: 16px; }
.lang-select { appearance: none; background: rgba(10, 74, 40, 0.8); color: var(--text); border: 1px solid var(--edge); border-radius: 999px; padding: 9px 34px 9px 14px; font: inherit; font-size: 0.82rem; backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  background-image: linear-gradient(45deg, transparent 50%, var(--mint) 50%), linear-gradient(135deg, var(--mint) 50%, transparent 50%); background-position: calc(100% - 18px) 55%, calc(100% - 13px) 55%; background-size: 5px 5px; background-repeat: no-repeat; }
.lang-select option { background: #0e5a32; color: #fff; }
.mic-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 9px 16px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.82rem; color: var(--bg0); background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--mint), var(--leaf)); box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0, 50, 25, 0.35); }
.mic-btn svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; }
.mic-btn.on { background: var(--gold); animation: micpulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes micpulse { 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 10px rgba(243, 215, 122, 0.0), 0 0 30px rgba(243, 215, 122, 0.7); } }
.voice-bubble { position: fixed; left: 50%; bottom: 22px; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(20px); z-index: 60; max-width: min(640px, 92vw); padding: 12px 18px; border-radius: 18px; background: rgba(10, 74, 40, 0.95); border: 1px solid var(--edge); color: var(--text); font-size: 0.92rem; box-shadow: var(--shadow); opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: 0.3s ease; }
.voice-bubble.show { opacity: 1; transform: translateX(-50%); }
.voice-bubble b { color: var(--mint); }
.voice-bubble { min-width: min(420px, 92vw); font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5; }
.cap-you { color: var(--gold); margin-bottom: 4px; } .cap-you:empty { display: none; } .cap-you b { color: var(--gold); }
.cap-dots { opacity: 0.7; }
.cap-guide .w { transition: color 0.12s, background 0.12s; border-radius: 4px; padding: 0 1px; }
.cap-guide .w.said { color: var(--text-soft); }
.cap-guide .w.now { background: var(--mint); color: #0b4a2a; }

/* ---------- screens ---------- */
.screen { display: none; min-height: 100vh; padding: 28px 6%; }
.screen.active { display: flex; flex-direction: column; animation: fadeIn 0.8s ease both; }
@keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }

/* ---------- welcome ---------- */
.welcome { align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center; position: relative; }
#welcomeGlobe { width: min(460px, 82vw); height: min(460px, 82vw); margin: 0 auto 6px; cursor: grab; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 40px rgba(200, 255, 220, 0.25)); }
.eyebrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 7px 16px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(124, 240, 176, 0.4); background: rgba(124, 240, 176, 0.08); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.24em; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--mint); margin-bottom: 18px; text-shadow: none; }
.eyebrow::before { content: ""; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--mint); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--mint); animation: blink 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes blink { 50% { opacity: 0.3; transform: scale(0.7); } }
.welcome h1 { font-size: clamp(2.8rem, 7vw, 5.6rem); line-height: 1.02; max-width: 960px; color: #f4fff8;
  text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18), 0 2px 10px rgba(0, 40, 20, 0.35);
  animation: glow 5s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
.welcome h1 em { font-style: italic; color: var(--leaf); }
@keyframes glow { from { text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12), 0 2px 10px rgba(0, 40, 20, 0.35); } to { text-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.24), 0 2px 10px rgba(0, 40, 20, 0.35); } }
.subtitle { color: var(--text-soft); font-size: 1.1rem; line-height: 1.7; max-width: 600px; margin: 10px auto 0; }
.voice-hint { margin-top: 18px; font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-dim); }
.voice-hint kbd { background: rgba(124, 240, 176, 0.12); border: 1px solid var(--edge); border-radius: 6px; padding: 1px 7px; color: var(--mint); font-family: inherit; }

/* ---------- buttons ---------- */
.primary-btn { position: relative; overflow: hidden; border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 15px 36px; margin-top: 28px; color: var(--bg0); background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--mint), var(--leaf)); font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.08em; font-size: 0.85rem; text-transform: uppercase; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0, 50, 25, 0.35); transition: transform 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s, opacity 0.25s; }
.primary-btn::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; left: -60%; width: 40%; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(100deg, transparent, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75), transparent); transform: skewX(-20deg); transition: left 0.6s; }
.primary-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(0, 50, 25, 0.4); }
.primary-btn:hover:not(:disabled)::after { left: 130%; }
.primary-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.35; cursor: not-allowed; }
.ghost-btn { border: 1px solid var(--edge); background: rgba(124, 240, 176, 0.08); color: var(--text); border-radius: 999px; padding: 10px 18px; font-size: 0.84rem; font-weight: 600; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s; }
.ghost-btn:hover { background: rgba(124, 240, 176, 0.2); transform: translateY(-1px); }
.ghost-btn.on { background: var(--mint); color: var(--bg0); border-color: var(--mint); }

/* ---------- age ---------- */
.center-title { text-align: center; margin: 60px 0 6px; font-size: clamp(2rem, 4.5vw, 3.2rem); text-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 40, 20, 0.3); }
.center-description { text-align: center; color: var(--text-soft); margin: 0 auto 40px; }
.age-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 22px; max-width: 1040px; width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; }
.age-card { position: relative; font: inherit; color: inherit; background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(34, 140, 78, 0.75), rgba(14, 88, 48, 0.75)); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 32px 26px; text-align: start; box-shadow: var(--shadow); transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), box-shadow 0.35s; }
.age-card:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 26px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); }
.age-card.selected { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--mint); }
.age-card .range { font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--leaf); font-weight: 700; }
.age-card h2 { font-size: 1.8rem; margin-top: 8px; }
.age-card p { color: var(--text-soft); font-size: 0.95rem; margin: 0; }
#continueBtn { display: block; margin: 40px auto; }

/* ---------- main ---------- */
header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 15px; flex-wrap: wrap; padding-right: 560px; padding-bottom: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06); }
[dir="rtl"] header { padding-right: 0; padding-left: 560px; }
.logo { font-family: "Fraunces", Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; }
.logo::before { content: ""; display: inline-block; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--mint); margin-inline-end: 10px; box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--mint); vertical-align: middle; }
#ageLabel { font-size: 0.76rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-dim); }
.navigation { position: sticky; top: 14px; z-index: 10; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; width: fit-content; max-width: 100%; margin: 22px auto 0; padding: 7px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(10, 74, 40, 0.75); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(160%); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(160%); border: 1px solid var(--edge); box-shadow: 0 10px 35px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); }
.nav-tab { border: none; background: transparent; color: var(--text); border-radius: 999px; padding: 10px 20px; font-size: 0.86rem; font-weight: 600; transition: background 0.25s; }
.nav-tab:hover { background: rgba(124, 240, 176, 0.15); }
.nav-tab.active { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--jade), var(--emerald)); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 50, 25, 0.35); }
.content { max-width: 1140px; width: 100%; margin: 30px auto; }
.panel { display: none; } .panel.active { display: block; animation: fadeIn 0.5s ease both; }
.glass-card { position: relative; background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(34, 140, 78, 0.62), rgba(14, 88, 48, 0.68)); backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(130%); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(130%); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: clamp(22px, 4vw, 42px); box-shadow: var(--shadow); transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); }
.glass-card::before, .age-card::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit; padding: 1px; pointer-events: none; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(124, 240, 176, 0.7), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) 45%, rgba(184, 243, 107, 0.45)); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#000 0 0); -webkit-mask-composite: xor; mask-composite: exclude; opacity: 0.5; transition: opacity 0.3s; }
.glass-card:hover::before, .age-card:hover::before, .age-card.selected::before { opacity: 1; }
.grid-3 .glass-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); }
.glass-card + .glass-card, .grid-3 + .glass-card, .glass-card + .grid-3, .grid-3 + .grid-3 { margin-top: 20px; }
.panel h2 { font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 2.8rem); text-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 40, 20, 0.3); }
.panel h3 { font-size: 1.35rem; }
.panel p { color: var(--text-soft); margin: 0 0 0.6em; }
.grid-3 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 20px; }
.grid-3 .glass-card { padding: 26px; }
.tag { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 11px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(184, 243, 107, 0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(184, 243, 107, 0.3); font-size: 0.66rem; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--leaf); font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.formula { font-family: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--gold); }

/* ---------- jukebox ---------- */
.jukebox { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.6fr) minmax(290px, 1fr); gap: 20px; align-items: stretch; }
.globe-stage { position: relative; border-radius: var(--radius); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--edge); background: #000 url("https://unpkg.com/three-globe@2.45.6/example/img/night-sky.png") center / cover; box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6); min-height: 560px; }
#globe { width: 100%; height: 100%; min-height: 560px; cursor: crosshair; }
.globe-stage.original { background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%, #2a9a58 0%, #157a42 60%, #0d5a30 100%); }
.stage-controls { position: absolute; left: 16px; right: 16px; bottom: 16px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; z-index: 3; }
.stage-controls .ghost-btn { background: rgba(2, 13, 7, 0.6); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px); }
.stage-controls .ghost-btn.on { background: var(--mint); }
.stage-hint { position: absolute; top: 16px; left: 16px; z-index: 3; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(2, 13, 7, 0.6); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); color: var(--text-soft); font-size: 0.74rem; }
.readout { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }
.readout .coords { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-soft); }
.ndvi-value { font-family: "Fraunces", Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 4.4rem; line-height: 1; color: var(--mint); text-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 40, 20, 0.3); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.ndvi-value small { font-size: 1.2rem; color: var(--text-soft); text-shadow: none; }
.ndvi-class { font-weight: 700; color: #fff; font-size: 1.05rem; }
.meter { position: relative; height: 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #e9e2d6, #d8c9a5, #a9b86b, #5f9a2a, #1f6a12, #0b3d06); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); }
.meter-marker { position: absolute; top: 50%; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--gold); border: 3px solid var(--bg0); transform: translate(-50%, -50%); left: 0; transition: left 0.6s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); opacity: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--gold); }
.meter-scale { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--text-dim); }
.sound-desc, .extra-data { font-size: 0.88rem; color: var(--text-soft); border-top: 1px solid rgba(124, 240, 176, 0.18); padding-top: 12px; }
.presets { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
.status { font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--text-dim); }
.status.error { color: #ffb38a; }
.date-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.date-row input { border: 1px solid var(--edge); background: rgba(124, 240, 176, 0.08); border-radius: 999px; padding: 8px 14px; font: inherit; font-size: 0.85rem; color: #fff; color-scheme: dark; }
body.age-child .adult-only, body.age-teen .adult-only { display: none; }
footer { text-align: center; color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 0.78rem; padding: 30px 0 70px; margin-top: auto; }

/* ---------- place pop-up ---------- */
.place-pop { position: absolute; top: 56px; left: 16px; z-index: 5; width: min(370px, calc(100% - 32px)); max-height: calc(100% - 128px); overflow-y: auto; border-radius: 22px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(24, 120, 66, 0.95), rgba(10, 74, 40, 0.96)); backdrop-filter: blur(18px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(18px); border: 1px solid var(--edge); box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(0, 30, 15, 0.5); padding: 14px; opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px) scale(0.97); pointer-events: none; transition: 0.35s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); }
.place-pop.open { opacity: 1; transform: none; pointer-events: auto; }
.pop-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.pop-title { font-family: "Fraunces", Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.2rem; color: #fff; line-height: 1.2; }
.pop-sub { font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--text-dim); margin-top: 3px; }
.pop-close { flex: none; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06); color: #fff; }
.pop-close:hover { background: var(--mint); color: var(--bg0); }
.pop-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35); margin-bottom: 10px; }
.pop-tab { flex: 1; border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 7px 6px; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-soft); background: transparent; }
.pop-tab.on { background: var(--mint); color: var(--bg0); }
.pop-media { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; background: #010a05; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); }
.pop-media img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; transition: opacity 0.3s; }
.pop-media img.loading { opacity: 0.25; }
.pop-badge { position: absolute; left: 8px; bottom: 8px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(2, 13, 7, 0.8); color: #fff; font-size: 0.68rem; }
.pop-play { position: absolute; right: 8px; bottom: 8px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; padding: 5px 12px; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; background: var(--mint); color: var(--bg0); display: none; }
.pop-media.lapse .pop-play { display: block; }
.pop-cross { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; width: 22px; height: 22px; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); border: 2px solid var(--gold); border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--gold); pointer-events: none; }
.pop-info { font-size: 0.86rem; line-height: 1.65; margin: 12px 2px 6px; color: var(--text); }
.pop-facts { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin: 8px 0; }
.pop-facts span { font-size: 0.7rem; padding: 4px 9px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(124, 240, 176, 0.12); border: 1px solid var(--edge); color: var(--text); }
.sdg-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; margin-top: 22px; }
.sdg-lead { width: 100%; text-align: center; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-dim); }
.sdg { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 7px 14px 7px 9px; border-radius: 10px; color: #fff; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 800; font-size: 0.68rem; line-height: 1.1; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); transition: transform 0.2s; }
.sdg b { font-size: 1.6rem; line-height: 1; }
.sdg:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }
.sdg4 { background: #C5192D; } .sdg13 { background: #3F7E44; }
.panel .sdg-row { justify-content: flex-start; } .panel .sdg-lead { text-align: left; }
.vid-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin: 14px 0; }
.vid-frame { position: relative; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.35); }
.vid-frame iframe { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0; }
.vid-thumb { display: block; text-decoration: none; color: #fff; }
.vid-thumb img { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; opacity: 0.85; transition: opacity 0.2s; }
.vid-thumb:hover img { opacity: 1; }
.vid-playicon { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 64px; height: 44px; border-radius: 12px; background: #e62117; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 1.3rem; box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); }
.vid-cap { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; padding: 18px 12px 10px; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700; background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(0,0,0,0.75)); }
.vid-cap small { font-weight: 500; opacity: 0.8; }
.vid-open { display: inline-block; margin-top: 6px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--mint); text-decoration: none; }
.vid-open:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.vid-note { font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--text-dim); margin-top: 8px; }
.pop-vid-btn { display: block; width: 100%; margin: 8px 0; padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--edge); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: var(--mint); font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.8rem; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; }
.pop-vid-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); }
.pop-vid { margin-bottom: 8px; border-radius: 12px; }
[hidden] { display: none !important; }
.pop-link { display: inline-block; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--mint); text-decoration: none; }
.pop-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.pop-credit { font-size: 0.64rem; color: var(--text-dim); margin-top: 8px; }

@media (max-width: 900px) { .jukebox { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .globe-stage, #globe { min-height: 440px; } .grid-3, .age-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } header { padding-right: 0; padding-top: 50px; } }
@media (max-width: 600px) { .navigation { border-radius: 28px; } .nav-tab { padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 0.78rem; } .place-pop { top: auto; bottom: 64px; max-height: 70%; } .mic-btn span { display: none; } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation: none !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; } }

.cmd-input { width: 250px; background: rgba(10, 74, 40, 0.8); color: var(--text); border: 1px solid var(--edge); border-radius: 999px; padding: 9px 14px; font: inherit; font-size: 0.82rem; backdrop-filter: blur(12px); }
.cmd-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-dim); }
@media (max-width: 900px) { .cmd-input { width: 150px; } }

.motto { margin: 16px auto 0; font-family: "Fraunces", Georgia, serif; font-style: italic; font-size: 1.15rem; color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15); }
.motto span { display: block; margin-top: 4px; font-family: "Outfit", system-ui, sans-serif; font-style: normal; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--mint); }
.motto-about { margin: 0 0 14px; text-align: start; }
.logo small { font-family: "Outfit", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--mint); margin-inline-start: 8px; }
footer b { color: #fff; } footer i { color: var(--text-soft); }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<a class="skip" href="#mainContent">Skip to content</a>
<div id="live" class="sr-only" aria-live="assertive"></div>

<div class="topbar">
  <label class="sr-only" for="langSelect" data-i18n="language">Language</label>
  <select id="langSelect" class="lang-select" aria-label="Language"></select>
  <form id="cmdForm" class="cmd-form" role="search" aria-label="Type a command">
    <input id="cmdInput" class="cmd-input" type="text" placeholder="Type a command, e.g. take me to Lusaka" aria-label="Type a command for the guide, for example: take me to Lusaka" autocomplete="off">
  </form>
  <button id="micBtn" class="mic-btn" aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Voice guide. Shortcut: press V" onclick="toggleListening()">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 15a3 3 0 0 0 3-3V6a3 3 0 0 0-6 0v6a3 3 0 0 0 3 3zm5-3a5 5 0 0 1-10 0H5a7 7 0 0 0 6 6.92V21h2v-2.08A7 7 0 0 0 19 12h-2z"/></svg>
    <span data-i18n="voice">Voice guide</span>
  </button>
</div>
<div class="voice-bubble" id="voiceBubble" role="status"></div>

<!-- SCREEN 1: WELCOME -->
<section id="welcome" class="screen active welcome" aria-label="Welcome">
  <div id="welcomeGlobe" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div class="eyebrow" data-i18n="eyebrow">NASA Space Apps · Sonification</div>
  <h1>Eco<em>Sonic</em></h1>
  <p class="subtitle" data-i18n="subtitle"></p>
  <p class="motto">“Exploring Earth’s Sounds to Protect Tomorrow’s Sights”<span>by Team Wurlitzer</span></p>
  <button class="primary-btn" onclick="showAge()" data-i18n="begin">Begin your journey</button>
  <p class="voice-hint">Press <kbd>V</kbd> or say <b>“help”</b> after tapping the microphone to explore by voice.</p>
  <div class="sdg-row" aria-label="Supports UN Sustainable Development Goals 4 and 13">
    <span class="sdg-lead">Supports the UN Sustainable Development Goals</span>
    <a class="sdg sdg4" href="https://sdgs.un.org/goals/goal4" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><b>4</b><span>Quality<br>Education</span></a>
    <a class="sdg sdg13" href="https://sdgs.un.org/goals/goal13" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><b>13</b><span>Climate<br>Action</span></a>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- SCREEN 2: AGE -->
<section id="ageScreen" class="screen" aria-label="Choose age group">
  <h1 class="center-title" data-i18n="who">Who is exploring today?</h1>
  <p class="center-description" data-i18n="chooseAge"></p>
  <div class="age-grid" role="radiogroup">
    <button class="age-card" role="radio" aria-checked="false" data-age="child" onclick="selectAge('child', this)">
      <span class="range" data-i18n="yrsChild"></span><h2 data-i18n="child"></h2><p data-long="cardChild"></p>
    </button>
    <button class="age-card" role="radio" aria-checked="false" data-age="teen" onclick="selectAge('teen', this)">
      <span class="range" data-i18n="yrsTeen"></span><h2 data-i18n="teen"></h2><p data-long="cardTeen"></p>
    </button>
    <button class="age-card" role="radio" aria-checked="false" data-age="adult" onclick="selectAge('adult', this)">
      <span class="range" data-i18n="yrsAdult"></span><h2 data-i18n="adult"></h2><p data-long="cardAdult"></p>
    </button>
  </div>
  <button id="continueBtn" class="primary-btn" onclick="enterApp()" disabled data-i18n="cont">Continue to exploration</button>
</section>

<!-- SCREEN 3: APP -->
<section id="mainApp" class="screen" aria-label="EcoSonic">
  <header>
    <div class="logo">EcoSonic <small>by Team Wurlitzer</small></div>
    <div id="ageLabel"></div>
  </header>
  <nav class="navigation" aria-label="Sections">
    <button class="nav-tab active" data-tab="home" data-i18n="home">Home</button>
    <button class="nav-tab" data-tab="jukebox" data-i18n="jukebox">NDVI Jukebox</button>
    <button class="nav-tab" data-tab="sounds" data-i18n="sounds">Sonification</button>
    <button class="nav-tab" data-tab="learn" data-i18n="learn">Learn</button>
    <button class="nav-tab" data-tab="about" data-i18n="about">About</button>
  </nav>

  <main class="content" id="mainContent" tabindex="-1">
    <div class="panel active" id="panel-home">
      <div class="glass-card">
        <span class="tag" data-i18n="home">Home</span>
        <h2 data-long="greeting"></h2>
        <p data-long="greetingDesc"></p>
        <button class="primary-btn" onclick="goTab('jukebox')" data-i18n="openJukebox">Open the NDVI Jukebox</button>
      </div>
      <div class="grid-3">
        <div class="glass-card"><span class="tag">1</span><h3 data-long="seeT"></h3><p data-long="seeD"></p></div>
        <div class="glass-card"><span class="tag">2</span><h3 data-long="touchT"></h3><p data-long="touchD"></p></div>
        <div class="glass-card"><span class="tag">3</span><h3 data-long="listenT"></h3><p data-long="listenD"></p></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="panel" id="panel-jukebox">
      <div class="jukebox">
        <div class="globe-stage">
          <div id="globe" role="application" aria-label="3D Earth globe. Use the voice guide or the place buttons to choose a location."></div>
          <div class="place-pop" id="placePop" role="dialog" aria-labelledby="popTitle">
            <div class="pop-head">
              <div><div class="pop-title" id="popTitle">—</div><div class="pop-sub" id="popSub"></div></div>
              <button class="pop-close" onclick="closePop()" aria-label="Close">✕</button>
            </div>
            <div class="pop-tabs" role="tablist">
              <button class="pop-tab on" data-view="true" onclick="popView('true')" data-i18n="trueColour">True colour</button>
              <button class="pop-tab" data-view="ndvi" onclick="popView('ndvi')" data-i18n="ndvi">NDVI</button>
              <button class="pop-tab" data-view="lapse" onclick="popView('lapse')" data-i18n="video">12-month video</button>
            </div>
            <div class="pop-media" id="popMedia">
              <img id="popImg" alt="">
              <div class="pop-cross"></div>
              <div class="pop-badge" id="popBadge"></div>
              <button class="pop-play" id="popPlay" onclick="toggleLapse()" data-i18n="pause">Pause</button>
            </div>
            <div class="pop-facts" id="popFacts"></div>
            <div class="pop-info" id="popInfo"></div>
            <button class="pop-vid-btn" id="popVidBtn" onclick="togglePopVideo()" hidden>▶ Watch a video about this place</button>
            <div class="pop-vid" id="popVid" hidden></div>
            <a class="pop-link" id="popLink" target="_blank" rel="noopener" data-i18n="worldview">Explore in NASA Worldview</a>
            <div class="pop-credit">NASA GIBS · MODIS Terra true colour (daily) and NDVI (8-day composites).</div>
          </div>
          <div class="stage-hint" data-i18n="hint"></div>
          <div class="stage-controls">
            <button class="ghost-btn" id="ndviToggle" onclick="toggleNDVI()" data-i18n="showLayer">Show NDVI layer</button>
            <button class="ghost-btn on" id="spinToggle" onclick="toggleSpin()" data-i18n="spinning">Spinning</button>
            <button class="ghost-btn" onclick="stopSound()" data-i18n="stop">Stop sound</button>
            <button class="ghost-btn" id="styleToggle" onclick="toggleGlobeStyle()">Globe: original</button>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="glass-card readout">
          <span class="tag" data-i18n="reading">Vegetation reading</span>
          <div class="coords" id="coords" data-i18n="clickGlobe"></div>
          <div class="ndvi-value" id="ndviValue" aria-live="polite">—</div>
          <div class="ndvi-class" id="ndviClass" data-i18n="awaiting"></div>
          <div class="meter" aria-hidden="true"><div class="meter-marker" id="meterMarker"></div></div>
          <div class="meter-scale" aria-hidden="true"><span id="scaleLo">0</span><span id="scaleMid">0.5</span><span id="scaleHi">1</span></div>
          <div class="extra-data" id="extraData" hidden></div>
          <div class="sound-desc" id="soundDesc" data-long="soundIdle"></div>
          <div>
            <span class="tag" data-i18n="tryPlace">Try a place</span>
            <div class="presets">
              <button class="ghost-btn" onclick="goTo(-3.5, -62, 'Amazon Rainforest')">Amazon</button>
              <button class="ghost-btn" onclick="goTo(0.5, 23, 'Congo Basin')">Congo</button>
              <button class="ghost-btn" onclick="goTo(-15.8, 26, 'Kafue, Zambia')">Kafue</button>
              <button class="ghost-btn" onclick="goTo(23, 12, 'Sahara Desert')">Sahara</button>
              <button class="ghost-btn" onclick="goTo(48.5, 9, 'Black Forest')">Black Forest</button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span class="tag" data-i18n="dataDate">Data date</span>
            <div class="date-row">
              <input type="date" id="ndviDate" aria-label="NDVI data date">
              <button class="ghost-btn" onclick="reloadNDVI()" data-i18n="load">Load</button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="status" id="status" data-i18n="loading"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="panel" id="panel-sounds">
      <div class="glass-card"><span class="tag" data-i18n="sounds">Sonification</span><h2 data-long="sonT"></h2><p data-long="sonD"></p></div>
      <div class="grid-3">
        <div class="glass-card"><span class="tag">♪</span><h3 data-long="pitchT"></h3><p data-long="pitchD"></p></div>
        <div class="glass-card"><span class="tag">♫</span><h3 data-long="densT"></h3><p data-long="densD"></p></div>
        <div class="glass-card"><span class="tag">♬</span><h3 data-long="toneT"></h3><p data-long="toneD"></p></div>
      </div>
      <div class="glass-card">
        <h3 data-long="rangeT"></h3>
        <div class="presets">
          <button class="ghost-btn" onclick="demo(0.05)">Desert · 0.05</button>
          <button class="ghost-btn" onclick="demo(0.3)">Grassland · 0.3</button>
          <button class="ghost-btn" onclick="demo(0.55)">Woodland · 0.55</button>
          <button class="ghost-btn" onclick="demo(0.85)">Rainforest · 0.85</button>
          <button class="ghost-btn" onclick="stopSound()" data-i18n="stop">Stop</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="panel" id="panel-learn">
      <div class="glass-card"><span class="tag" data-i18n="learn">Learn</span><h2 data-long="learnT"></h2><p data-long="learnIntro"></p><p data-long="learnBody"></p></div>
      <div class="grid-3">
        <div class="glass-card"><span class="tag">🛰</span><h3 data-long="l1T"></h3><p data-long="l1D"></p></div>
        <div class="glass-card"><span class="tag">8</span><h3 data-long="l2T"></h3><p data-long="l2D"></p></div>
        <div class="glass-card"><span class="tag">🌍</span><h3 data-long="l3T"></h3><p data-long="l3D"></p></div>
      </div>
      <div class="glass-card"><span class="tag">▶ Watch</span><h2 data-long="vidT"></h2><p data-long="vidD"></p>
        <div class="vid-chips">
          <button class="ghost-btn on" onclick="learnVideo('rxOMhQwApMc', this)">NDVI explained · Karen Joyce</button>
          <button class="ghost-btn" onclick="learnVideo('Fq92ERzWw6s', this)">Measuring vegetation from space · NOAA</button>
          <button class="ghost-btn" onclick="learnVideo('3oIcJBiynvw', this)">Our living planet from space · NASA</button>
        </div>
        <div id="learnVidBox"></div>
        <p class="vid-note">Videos come from YouTube and need an internet connection.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="glass-card"><span class="tag">Why it matters</span><h2 data-long="relT"></h2><p data-long="relIntro"></p><p data-long="relBody"></p></div>
      <div class="grid-3">
        <div class="glass-card"><span class="tag">🌽</span><h3 data-long="u1T"></h3><p data-long="u1D"></p></div>
        <div class="glass-card"><span class="tag">☀️</span><h3 data-long="u2T"></h3><p data-long="u2D"></p></div>
        <div class="glass-card"><span class="tag">🌳</span><h3 data-long="u3T"></h3><p data-long="u3D"></p></div>
      </div>
      <div class="grid-3">
        <div class="glass-card"><span class="tag">🦓</span><h3 data-long="u4T"></h3><p data-long="u4D"></p></div>
        <div class="glass-card"><span class="tag">🔥</span><h3 data-long="u5T"></h3><p data-long="u5D"></p></div>
        <div class="glass-card"><span class="tag">🏙️</span><h3 data-long="u6T"></h3><p data-long="u6D"></p></div>
      </div>
      <div class="glass-card"><span class="tag">Community impact</span><h2 data-long="commT"></h2><p data-long="commD"></p><p data-long="commD2"></p><p data-long="sdgD"></p></div>
      <div class="glass-card"><span class="tag">Good to know</span><h3 data-long="limT"></h3><p data-long="limD"></p></div>
    </div>

    <div class="panel" id="panel-about">
      <div class="glass-card">
        <span class="tag" data-i18n="about">About</span>
        <h2>EcoSonic</h2>
        <p class="motto motto-about">“Exploring Earth’s Sounds to Protect Tomorrow’s Sights”<span>Team Wurlitzer</span></p>
        <p data-long="aboutD"></p>
        <p data-long="sdgD"></p>
        <div class="sdg-row" aria-label="Supports UN Sustainable Development Goals 4 and 13">
          <span class="sdg-lead">Supports the UN Sustainable Development Goals</span>
          <a class="sdg sdg4" href="https://sdgs.un.org/goals/goal4" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><b>4</b><span>Quality<br>Education</span></a>
          <a class="sdg sdg13" href="https://sdgs.un.org/goals/goal13" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><b>13</b><span>Climate<br>Action</span></a>
        </div>
        <p>Data: <a href="https://nasa-gibs.github.io/gibs-api-docs/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">NASA GIBS</a>, <a href="https://www.earthdata.nasa.gov/data/catalog/lancemodis-mod13q4n-6.1nrt" target="_blank" rel="noopener">MODIS Terra NDVI 8-day composite</a>, <a href="https://worldview.earthdata.nasa.gov/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">NASA Worldview</a>. Imagery: <a href="https://science.nasa.gov/earth/earth-observatory/blue-marble-next-generation/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">NASA Blue Marble</a>. Globe: globe.gl and three.js. Place names: Open-Meteo and BigDataCloud.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </main>
  <footer>Made by <b>Team Wurlitzer</b> for the NASA Space Apps Challenge<br><i>“Exploring Earth’s Sounds to Protect Tomorrow’s Sights”</i></footer>
</section>

<script>
