/* ============================================================
   CONFIG
   ============================================================ */
const IMG = "https://unpkg.com/three-globe@2.45.6/example/img/";
const TEX = {
  earth: IMG + "earth-blue-marble.jpg",
  bump: IMG + "earth-topology.png",
  water: IMG + "earth-water.png",
  sky: IMG + "night-sky.png",
  clouds: "https://unpkg.com/globe.gl@2.46.2/example/clouds/clouds.png"
};
const NDVI_W = 2048, NDVI_H = 1024;
const GIBS = "https://gibs.earthdata.nasa.gov/wms/epsg4326/best/wms.cgi";
const LAYER_TRUE = "MODIS_Terra_CorrectedReflectance_TrueColor";
const LAYER_NDVI = "MODIS_Terra_NDVI_8Day";
function ndviUrl(date) {
  let url = GIBS + "?SERVICE=WMS&REQUEST=GetMap&VERSION=1.3.0&LAYERS=" + LAYER_NDVI +
    "&CRS=EPSG:4326&BBOX=-90,-180,90,180&WIDTH=" + NDVI_W + "&HEIGHT=" + NDVI_H + "&FORMAT=image/png";
  if (date) url += "&TIME=" + date;
  return url; /* no date = latest composite */
}

/* ============================================================
   STATE, LANGUAGE AND AGE
   ============================================================ */
const state = { lang: localStorage.getItem("eij-lang") || "en", age: "", lastPlace: null, lastNdvi: undefined, lastSpoken: "" };
const langInfo = () => LANGS.find(l => l.code === state.lang) || LANGS[0];
const t = key => (UI[state.lang] && UI[state.lang][key]) || UI.en[key] || key;
const ageKey = () => state.age || "teen";
const longText = key => (LONG[ageKey()] && LONG[ageKey()][key]) || COMMON[key] || "";

/* Translation of long text: Google Translate in the browser, cached, English fallback. */
const trCache = {};
async function translate(text, to, from) {
  if (!text || to === "en" && from === "en") return text;
  const k = (from || "auto") + ">" + to + ":" + text;
  if (trCache[k]) return trCache[k];
  try {
    const r = await fetch("https://translate.googleapis.com/translate_a/single?client=gtx&dt=t&sl=" + (from || "auto") + "&tl=" + to + "&q=" + encodeURIComponent(text));
    const j = await r.json();
    const out = j[0].map(p => p[0]).join("");
    trCache[k] = out;
    return out;
  } catch (e) { return text; }
}
const toUserLang = text => state.lang === "en" ? Promise.resolve(text) : translate(text, langInfo().gt, "en");

function applyLanguage() {
  const L = langInfo();
  document.documentElement.lang = state.lang;
  document.documentElement.dir = L.rtl ? "rtl" : "ltr";
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-i18n]").forEach(el => el.textContent = t(el.dataset.i18n));
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-long]").forEach(async el => {
    const src = longText(el.dataset.long);
    el.textContent = src;
    if (state.lang !== "en") { const out = await toUserLang(src); if (longText(el.dataset.long) === src) el.textContent = out; }
  });
  updateAgeLabel();
  document.getElementById("ndviToggle").textContent = showNDVI ? t("hideLayer") : t("showLayer");
  document.getElementById("spinToggle").textContent = spinning ? t("spinning") : t("paused");
  if (state.lastPlace) renderReadout(state.lastPlace.lat, state.lastPlace.lng, state.lastPlace.name, state.lastNdvi, true);
  if (recog) recog.lang = L.speech;
}
function setLanguage(code) {
  if (!LANGS.find(l => l.code === code)) return false;
  state.lang = code; localStorage.setItem("eij-lang", code);
  document.getElementById("langSelect").value = code;
  applyLanguage();
  return true;
}
function initLanguageMenu() {
  const sel = document.getElementById("langSelect");
  sel.innerHTML = LANGS.map(l => `<option value="${l.code}">${l.name}</option>`).join("");
  sel.value = state.lang;
  sel.addEventListener("change", () => { setLanguage(sel.value); say("Language changed to " + langInfo().name + "." + (langInfo().note ? " Browsers can't recognise this language yet, so please talk to me in English. I'll answer in " + langInfo().name + " with a Swahili voice, the closest one available." : "")); });
}
function updateAgeLabel() {
  if (!state.age) return;
  document.getElementById("ageLabel").textContent = t(state.age);
}

/* ============================================================
   SCREENS
   ============================================================ */
function showScreen(id) {
  document.querySelectorAll(".screen").forEach(s => s.classList.remove("active"));
  document.getElementById(id).classList.add("active");
  window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
}
function showAge() { if (welcomeGlobe) welcomeGlobe.pauseAnimation(); showScreen("ageScreen"); }
function selectAge(age, card) {
  state.age = age;
  document.body.classList.remove("age-child", "age-teen", "age-adult");
  document.body.classList.add("age-" + age);
  document.querySelectorAll(".age-card").forEach(c => { const on = c.dataset.age === age; c.classList.toggle("selected", on); c.setAttribute("aria-checked", on); });
  document.getElementById("continueBtn").disabled = false;
  applyLanguage();
}
function enterApp() {
  if (!state.age) return;
  showScreen("mainApp");
  applyLanguage();
  goTab("home");
}

/* ============================================================
   TABS
   ============================================================ */
document.querySelectorAll(".nav-tab").forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener("click", () => goTab(btn.dataset.tab)));
function goTab(tab) {
  if (!document.getElementById("mainApp").classList.contains("active")) {
    if (!state.age) selectAge("teen", document.querySelector('[data-age="teen"]'));
    showScreen("mainApp"); applyLanguage();
  }
  document.querySelectorAll(".nav-tab").forEach(b => { const on = b.dataset.tab === tab; b.classList.toggle("active", on); b.setAttribute("aria-current", on ? "page" : "false"); });
  document.querySelectorAll(".panel").forEach(p => p.classList.toggle("active", p.id === "panel-" + tab));
  if (tab === "jukebox") { if (!globe) initGlobe(); else { globe.resumeAnimation(); sizeGlobe(); } }
  else if (globe) globe.pauseAnimation();
}

/* ============================================================
   REALISTIC GLOBE (clouds, terrain bump, ocean glint, starfield)
   ============================================================ */
function makeRealistic(g, withClouds) {
  g.globeImageUrl(TEX.earth).bumpImageUrl(TEX.bump).showAtmosphere(true).atmosphereColor("#9fd8ff").atmosphereAltitude(0.2);
  const T = window.THREE;
  if (!T) return null;
  const mat = g.globeMaterial();
  mat.bumpScale = 10;
  new T.TextureLoader().load(TEX.water, tex => { g._water = tex; g._grey = new T.Color("grey"); applyGlobeStyle(g); });
  if (!withClouds) return null;
  let clouds = null;
  new T.TextureLoader().load(TEX.clouds, tex => {
    clouds = new T.Mesh(new T.SphereGeometry(g.getGlobeRadius() * 1.004, 75, 75), new T.MeshPhongMaterial({ map: tex, transparent: true, opacity: 0.85, depthWrite: false }));
    g.scene().add(clouds);
    g._clouds = clouds;
    applyGlobeStyle(g);
    (function spin() { if (clouds) clouds.rotation.y -= 0.006 * Math.PI / 180; requestAnimationFrame(spin); })();
  });
  return clouds;
}

/* Globe style: "original" = the first NDVI globe (Blue Marble + terrain), "realistic" = clouds, ocean glint, starfield. */
let globeStyle = localStorage.getItem("eij-globe") || "original";
function applyGlobeStyle(g) {
  if (!g) return;
  const real = globeStyle === "realistic";
  g.atmosphereColor(real ? "#9fd8ff" : "#d9ead0").atmosphereAltitude(real ? 0.2 : 0.18);
  const mat = g.globeMaterial();
  if (g._water) { mat.specularMap = real ? g._water : null; if (real) mat.specular = g._grey; mat.shininess = real ? 15 : 0; mat.needsUpdate = true; }
  if (g._clouds) g._clouds.visible = real && !(g === globe && showNDVI);
}
function setGlobeStyle(style) {
  globeStyle = style; localStorage.setItem("eij-globe", style);
  [welcomeGlobe, globe].forEach(applyGlobeStyle);
  document.querySelector(".globe-stage").classList.toggle("original", style === "original");
  const b = document.getElementById("styleToggle");
  b.textContent = style === "original" ? "Globe: original" : "Globe: realistic";
  b.setAttribute("aria-label", "Globe style: " + style + ". Press to switch.");
}
function toggleGlobeStyle() { setGlobeStyle(globeStyle === "original" ? "realistic" : "original"); }

let welcomeGlobe = null;
function initWelcomeGlobe() {
  const el = document.getElementById("welcomeGlobe");
  if (typeof Globe === "undefined") return;
  welcomeGlobe = new Globe(el).backgroundColor("rgba(0,0,0,0)").width(el.clientWidth).height(el.clientHeight);
  makeRealistic(welcomeGlobe, true);
  applyGlobeStyle(welcomeGlobe);
  const c = welcomeGlobe.controls(); c.autoRotate = true; c.autoRotateSpeed = 0.7; c.enableZoom = false;
  welcomeGlobe.pointOfView({ lat: -8, lng: 24, altitude: 2.2 });
}

let globe = null, showNDVI = false, spinning = true, ndviCtx = null, ndviTextureUrl = null, ndviDateLabel = "latest";
let ndviReadyResolve; let ndviReady = new Promise(r => ndviReadyResolve = r);

function initGlobe() {
  const el = document.getElementById("globe");
  globe = new Globe(el)
    .backgroundColor("rgba(0,0,0,0)")
    .ringColor(() => t => `rgba(243, 215, 122, ${1 - t})`)
    .ringMaxRadius(5).ringPropagationSpeed(3).ringRepeatPeriod(700)
    .onGlobeClick(({ lat, lng }) => probe(lat, lng));
  makeRealistic(globe, true);
  applyGlobeStyle(globe);
  const c = globe.controls(); c.autoRotate = true; c.autoRotateSpeed = 0.4;
  globe.pointOfView({ lat: -5, lng: 22, altitude: 2.2 });
  sizeGlobe(); window.addEventListener("resize", sizeGlobe);
  loadNDVI();
}
function sizeGlobe() { if (!globe) return; const el = document.getElementById("globe"); globe.width(el.clientWidth).height(el.clientHeight); }
function setSpin(on) {
  spinning = on; if (globe) globe.controls().autoRotate = on;
  const b = document.getElementById("spinToggle"); b.classList.toggle("on", on); b.textContent = on ? t("spinning") : t("paused");
}
function toggleSpin() { setSpin(!spinning); }
function setNDVILayer(on) {
  if (!ndviTextureUrl || !globe) return false;
  showNDVI = on;
  globe.globeImageUrl(on ? ndviTextureUrl : TEX.earth);
  applyGlobeStyle(globe);
  const b = document.getElementById("ndviToggle"); b.classList.toggle("on", on); b.textContent = on ? t("hideLayer") : t("showLayer");
  return true;
}
function toggleNDVI() { setNDVILayer(!showNDVI); }

async function goTo(lat, lng, name) {
  goTab("jukebox");
  setSpin(false);
  globe.pointOfView({ lat, lng, altitude: 1.5 }, 900);
  await ndviReady;
  await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 650));
  return probe(lat, lng, name);
}

/* ============================================================
   NDVI DATA (NASA GIBS, MODIS Terra 8-day composite)
   ============================================================ */
function loadImage(src) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => { const img = new Image(); img.crossOrigin = "anonymous"; img.onload = () => resolve(img); img.onerror = () => reject(new Error(src)); img.src = src; });
}
function setStatus(text, isError) { const s = document.getElementById("status"); s.textContent = text; s.classList.toggle("error", !!isError); }
async function loadNDVI(date) {
  setStatus(t("loading"));
  try {
    const [ndviImg, baseImg] = await Promise.all([loadImage(ndviUrl(date)), loadImage(TEX.earth)]);
    const dc = document.createElement("canvas"); dc.width = NDVI_W; dc.height = NDVI_H;
    ndviCtx = dc.getContext("2d", { willReadFrequently: true }); ndviCtx.drawImage(ndviImg, 0, 0);
    const vc = document.createElement("canvas"); vc.width = NDVI_W; vc.height = NDVI_H;
    const v = vc.getContext("2d"); v.drawImage(baseImg, 0, 0, NDVI_W, NDVI_H); v.globalAlpha = 0.88; v.drawImage(ndviImg, 0, 0);
    ndviTextureUrl = vc.toDataURL("image/jpeg", 0.9);
    if (showNDVI) globe.globeImageUrl(ndviTextureUrl);
    ndviDateLabel = date || "latest";
    setStatus("NASA MODIS Terra NDVI, 8-day composite (" + ndviDateLabel + ").");
    ndviReadyResolve();
  } catch (err) {
    setStatus("Couldn't reach NASA's NDVI service. Check your connection and press Load.", true);
  }
}
function reloadNDVI() { ndviReady = new Promise(r => ndviReadyResolve = r); loadNDVI(document.getElementById("ndviDate").value || undefined); }
function colorToNDVI(r, g, b) {
  let best = null, bestD = Infinity;
  for (const [R, G, B, val] of LUT) { const d = (r - R) ** 2 + (g - G) ** 2 + (b - B) ** 2; if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = val; } }
  return bestD < 400 ? best : null;
}
let lastSampleCount = 0;
function sampleNDVI(lat, lng) {
  if (!ndviCtx) return undefined;
  const x = Math.floor((lng + 180) / 360 * NDVI_W), y = Math.floor((90 - lat) / 180 * NDVI_H);
  const d = ndviCtx.getImageData(x - 2, y - 2, 5, 5).data;
  let sum = 0, n = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) {
    if (d[i + 3] < 128) continue;
    const v = colorToNDVI(d[i], d[i + 1], d[i + 2]);
    if (v !== null) { sum += v; n++; }
  }
  lastSampleCount = n;
  return n ? sum / n : null;
}
function classIndex(ndvi) { if (ndvi === null) return 0; if (ndvi < 0.1) return 1; if (ndvi < 0.2) return 2; if (ndvi < 0.4) return 3; if (ndvi < 0.6) return 4; return 5; }
function classify(ndvi) { return t("c" + classIndex(ndvi)); }

/* ============================================================
   PROBE + AGE-TAILORED READOUT
   ============================================================ */
function coordText(lat, lng) {
  return Math.abs(lat).toFixed(2) + "° " + (lat >= 0 ? "N" : "S") + ", " + Math.abs(lng).toFixed(2) + "° " + (lng >= 0 ? "E" : "W");
}
function renderReadout(lat, lng, name, ndvi, quiet) {
  document.getElementById("coords").textContent = (name ? name + " · " : "") + coordText(lat, lng);
  const val = document.getElementById("ndviValue"), extra = document.getElementById("extraData");
  if (ndvi === null) val.textContent = "—";
  else if (state.age === "child") val.innerHTML = Math.round(Math.max(0, ndvi) * 100) + "<small> / 100</small>";
  else if (state.age === "adult") val.textContent = ndvi.toFixed(3);
  else val.textContent = ndvi.toFixed(2);
  document.getElementById("ndviClass").textContent = (state.age === "child" ? t("greenness") + ": " : "") + classify(ndvi);
  const child = state.age === "child";
  document.getElementById("scaleLo").textContent = child ? "0" : "0 · bare";
  document.getElementById("scaleMid").textContent = child ? "50" : "0.5";
  document.getElementById("scaleHi").textContent = child ? "100" : "1 · dense";
  if (state.age === "adult" && ndvi !== undefined) {
    extra.hidden = false;
    extra.textContent = "Source: " + LAYER_NDVI + " (" + ndviDateLabel + ") · window 5 × 5 px ≈ 0.9° · valid pixels " + lastSampleCount + "/25 · palette lookup ±0.01";
  } else extra.hidden = true;
  const m = document.getElementById("meterMarker");
  if (ndvi === null) m.style.opacity = 0; else { m.style.opacity = 1; m.style.left = (Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ndvi)) * 100) + "%"; }
}
function spokenReading(name, ndvi) {
  const where = name || "this place";
  if (ndvi === null) return where + " has no vegetation signal. It is water, ice or cloud.";
  if (state.age === "child") return where + " has a greenness score of " + Math.round(Math.max(0, ndvi) * 100) + " out of 100. " + GENERIC_INFO.child[classIndex(ndvi)];
  return where + ": NDVI " + ndvi.toFixed(2) + ". " + UI.en["c" + classIndex(ndvi)].replace(" · ", ", ") + ".";
}
function probe(lat, lng, name) {
  const ndvi = sampleNDVI(lat, lng);
  if (ndvi === undefined) { setStatus(t("loading")); return null; }
  if (globe) globe.ringsData([{ lat, lng }]);
  state.lastPlace = { lat, lng, name }; state.lastNdvi = ndvi;
  renderReadout(lat, lng, name, ndvi);
  const desc = playNDVI(ndvi);
  toUserLang(desc).then(s => document.getElementById("soundDesc").textContent = s);
  openPlaceCard(lat, lng, name, ndvi);
  return ndvi;
}

/* ============================================================
   PLACE POP-UP: NASA imagery of the selected place
   ============================================================ */
let pop = { lat: 0, lng: 0, view: "true", frames: [], timer: null, idx: 0, playing: true, name: "" };
const isoDate = d => d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
function trueColorDate() { const d = new Date(); d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() - 3); return isoDate(d); }
function boxAround(lat, lng, half) { return { s: Math.max(-90, lat - half), w: Math.max(-180, lng - half), n: Math.min(90, lat + half), e: Math.min(180, lng + half) }; }
function gibsSnapshot(layer, lat, lng, date, half) {
  const b = boxAround(lat, lng, half || 2);
  let url = GIBS + "?SERVICE=WMS&REQUEST=GetMap&VERSION=1.3.0&LAYERS=" + layer + "&CRS=EPSG:4326&BBOX=" +
    [b.s, b.w, b.n, b.e].map(v => v.toFixed(3)).join(",") + "&WIDTH=512&HEIGHT=512&FORMAT=image/jpeg";
  if (date) url += "&TIME=" + date;
  return url;
}
function worldviewLink(lat, lng, date) { const b = boxAround(lat, lng, 3); return "https://worldview.earthdata.nasa.gov/?v=" + [b.w, b.s, b.e, b.n].map(v => v.toFixed(2)).join(",") + "&l=" + LAYER_TRUE + "&t=" + date; }
function setImg(src, badge, alt) {
  const img = document.getElementById("popImg"); img.classList.add("loading");
  const pre = new Image();
  pre.onload = () => { img.src = src; img.alt = alt; img.classList.remove("loading"); };
  pre.onerror = () => { img.classList.remove("loading"); document.getElementById("popBadge").textContent = "Imagery unavailable for this date"; };
  pre.src = src;
  document.getElementById("popBadge").textContent = badge;
}
function stopLapse() { if (pop.timer) clearInterval(pop.timer); pop.timer = null; }
function popView(view) {
  pop.view = view;
  document.querySelectorAll(".pop-tab").forEach(b => { const on = b.dataset.view === view; b.classList.toggle("on", on); b.setAttribute("aria-selected", on); });
  document.getElementById("popMedia").classList.toggle("lapse", view === "lapse");
  stopLapse();
  const place = pop.name || "the selected place";
  if (view === "true") { const d = trueColorDate(); setImg(gibsSnapshot(LAYER_TRUE, pop.lat, pop.lng, d), "MODIS true colour · " + d, "NASA MODIS true-colour satellite photo of " + place + " on " + d); }
  else if (view === "ndvi") setImg(gibsSnapshot(LAYER_NDVI, pop.lat, pop.lng), "MODIS NDVI · latest 8-day", "NASA MODIS NDVI map of " + place + ": darker green means denser vegetation");
  else startLapse();
}
function startLapse() {
  const now = new Date(); pop.frames = [];
  for (let i = 12; i >= 1; i--) {
    const d = new Date(Date.UTC(now.getUTCFullYear(), now.getUTCMonth() - i, 15));
    const label = d.toLocaleString(state.lang === "zh" ? "zh-CN" : state.lang, { month: "short", year: "numeric", timeZone: "UTC" });
    const src = gibsSnapshot(LAYER_NDVI, pop.lat, pop.lng, isoDate(d));
    const im = new Image(); im.src = src;
    pop.frames.push({ src, label });
  }
  pop.idx = 0; pop.playing = true; document.getElementById("popPlay").textContent = t("pause");
  showFrame();
  pop.timer = setInterval(() => { if (!pop.playing) return; pop.idx = (pop.idx + 1) % pop.frames.length; showFrame(); }, 750);
}
function showFrame() {
  const f = pop.frames[pop.idx], img = document.getElementById("popImg");
  img.classList.remove("loading"); img.src = f.src; img.alt = "NDVI time-lapse frame, " + f.label;
  document.getElementById("popBadge").textContent = "NDVI · " + f.label;
}
function setLapsePlaying(on) { pop.playing = on; document.getElementById("popPlay").textContent = on ? t("pause") : t("play"); }
function toggleLapse() { setLapsePlaying(!pop.playing); }

async function placeName(lat, lng) {
  try {
    const r = await fetch("https://api.bigdatacloud.net/data/reverse-geocode-client?latitude=" + lat + "&longitude=" + lng + "&localityLanguage=en");
    const j = await r.json();
    const parts = [j.locality || j.city, j.principalSubdivision, j.countryName].filter(Boolean);
    const uniq = parts.filter((p, i) => parts.indexOf(p) === i);
    if (uniq.length) return uniq.join(", ");
    const info = (j.localityInfo && j.localityInfo.informative) || [];
    const sea = info.find(x => /ocean|sea/i.test(x.name || ""));
    return sea ? sea.name : null;
  } catch (e) { return null; }
}

const PLACE_VIDEO = {
  "Amazon Rainforest": { id: "c4-KpR1HrNs", title: "Tracking Amazon Deforestation · NASA Goddard" },
  "Congo Basin": { id: "llemvhyft7Q", title: "The world's second-largest rainforest is at a turning point · Mongabay" },
  "Kafue, Zambia": { id: "7xyaDGi9q8c", title: "Inside Kafue: Zambia's Most Underrated National Park" },
  "Sahara Desert": { id: "s7lVGhTPQAY", title: "Desert Dust Feeds Amazon Forests · NASA Science" },
  "Black Forest": { id: "3oIcJBiynvw", title: "Our Living Planet From Space · NASA Goddard" }
};
/* YouTube only plays embeds when it can see the page's web address. Opened as a local file or inside a preview frame
   it shows "Error 153", so there we show the video's picture and open it on YouTube instead. */
const CAN_EMBED = /^https?:$/.test(location.protocol) && (() => { try { return window.self === window.top; } catch (e) { return false; } })();
function ytWatch(id) { return "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=" + id; }
function ytEmbed(id, title, autoplay) {
  const safe = String(title).replace(/[<>"&]/g, "");
  const link = '<a class="vid-open" href="' + ytWatch(id) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open on YouTube ↗</a>';
  if (!CAN_EMBED) return '<a class="vid-frame vid-thumb" href="' + ytWatch(id) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="Watch ' + safe + ' on YouTube"><img src="https://i.ytimg.com/vi/' + id + '/hqdefault.jpg" alt=""><span class="vid-playicon">▶</span><span class="vid-cap">' + safe + '<br><small>Opens on YouTube</small></span></a>';
  const src = "https://www.youtube.com/embed/" + id + "?rel=0&playsinline=1&enablejsapi=0" + (autoplay ? "&autoplay=1" : "") + "&origin=" + encodeURIComponent(location.origin);
  return '<div class="vid-frame"><iframe src="' + src + '" title="' + safe + '" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin"></iframe></div>' + link;
}
const LEARN_VIDEOS = { rxOMhQwApMc: "NDVI explained · Karen Joyce", Fq92ERzWw6s: "Measuring vegetation from space · NOAA", "3oIcJBiynvw": "Our living planet from space · NASA Goddard" };
function learnVideo(id, btn, autoplay = true) {
  document.getElementById("learnVidBox").innerHTML = ytEmbed(id, LEARN_VIDEOS[id] || "NDVI video", autoplay);
  if (btn) document.querySelectorAll(".vid-chips .ghost-btn").forEach(b => b.classList.toggle("on", b === btn));
}
function setPopVideo(name) {
  const v = PLACE_VIDEO[name], btn = document.getElementById("popVidBtn"), box = document.getElementById("popVid");
  box.innerHTML = ""; box.hidden = true;
  btn.hidden = !v;
  if (v) btn.textContent = "▶ Watch: " + v.title;
}
function togglePopVideo() {
  const v = PLACE_VIDEO[pop.name], box = document.getElementById("popVid");
  if (!v) return;
  if (box.hidden) { box.innerHTML = ytEmbed(v.id, v.title, true); box.hidden = false; }
  else { box.innerHTML = ""; box.hidden = true; }
}
function placeInfoText(name, ndvi) {
  const k = state.age === "child" ? "child" : "other";
  if (name && PLACE_INFO[name]) return PLACE_INFO[name][k];
  return GENERIC_INFO[k][classIndex(ndvi)];
}
async function openPlaceCard(lat, lng, name, ndvi) {
  pop.lat = lat; pop.lng = lng; pop.name = name || "";
  document.getElementById("popTitle").textContent = name || "…";
  document.getElementById("popSub").textContent = coordText(lat, lng) + (state.age === "child" ? "" : " · ~440 km across");
  const score = ndvi === null ? "—" : state.age === "child" ? Math.round(Math.max(0, ndvi) * 100) + "/100" : ndvi.toFixed(state.age === "adult" ? 3 : 2);
  document.getElementById("popFacts").innerHTML = "<span>" + (state.age === "child" ? t("greenness") : "NDVI") + " " + score + "</span><span>" + classify(ndvi) + "</span>";
  const info = placeInfoText(name, ndvi);
  document.getElementById("popInfo").textContent = info;
  toUserLang(info).then(s => { if (pop.lat === lat && pop.lng === lng) document.getElementById("popInfo").textContent = s; });
  document.getElementById("popLink").href = worldviewLink(lat, lng, trueColorDate());
  setPopVideo(name);
  document.getElementById("placePop").classList.add("open");
  popView(pop.view === "lapse" ? "lapse" : "true");
  if (!name) {
    const found = await placeName(lat.toFixed(3), lng.toFixed(3));
    if (pop.lat === lat && pop.lng === lng) {
      pop.name = found || "Remote area";
      document.getElementById("popTitle").textContent = pop.name;
      state.lastPlace.name = pop.name;
      document.getElementById("coords").textContent = pop.name + " · " + coordText(lat, lng);
    }
  }
}
function closePop() { stopLapse(); setPopVideo(""); document.getElementById("placePop").classList.remove("open"); }

/* ============================================================
   SONIFICATION ENGINE
   ============================================================ */
let actx = null, voice = null;
const PENTATONIC = [0, 2, 4, 7, 9];
function audio() { if (!actx) actx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)(); if (actx.state === "suspended") actx.resume(); return actx; }
function scaleFreq(step) { const octave = Math.floor(step / 5); return 110 * Math.pow(2, (octave * 12 + PENTATONIC[step % 5]) / 12); }
function stopSound() {
  if (!voice || !actx) return;
  const g = voice, t0 = actx.currentTime;
  g.gain.cancelScheduledValues(t0); g.gain.setValueAtTime(g.gain.value, t0); g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, t0 + 0.15);
  setTimeout(() => g.disconnect(), 250); voice = null;
}
function playNDVI(ndvi) {
  stopSound();
  const ac = audio(), t0 = ac.currentTime + 0.05;
  const master = ac.createGain(); master.gain.value = 1.0;
  const comp = ac.createDynamicsCompressor(); comp.threshold.value = -14; comp.knee.value = 10; comp.ratio.value = 6; comp.attack.value = 0.005; comp.release.value = 0.2;
  const boost = ac.createGain(); boost.gain.value = 1.6;
  const filter = ac.createBiquadFilter(); filter.type = "lowpass"; filter.connect(master); master.connect(comp); comp.connect(boost); boost.connect(ac.destination);
  voice = master;
  if (ndvi === null) {
    const len = ac.sampleRate * 2.5, buf = ac.createBuffer(1, len, ac.sampleRate), ch = buf.getChannelData(0);
    for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) ch[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
    const src = ac.createBufferSource(); src.buffer = buf;
    const g = ac.createGain(); filter.frequency.value = 500;
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0, t0); g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.3, t0 + 1); g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, t0 + 2.5);
    src.connect(g).connect(filter); src.start(t0);
    return state.age === "child" ? "Listen: soft waves, because there are no plants here." : "Sound: a gentle ocean wash, since there is no vegetation signal here.";
  }
  const v = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, ndvi));
  const step = Math.round(v * 10), count = 3 + Math.round(v * 5), gap = 0.45 - v * 0.23;
  const wave = v < 0.25 ? "triangle" : "sine";
  filter.frequency.value = 600 + v * 3600;
  const pattern = [0, 2, 4, 2, 5, 4, 7, 5], end = t0 + count * gap + 1.2;
  const drone = ac.createOscillator(), dg = ac.createGain();
  drone.type = "sine"; drone.frequency.value = scaleFreq(step) / 2;
  dg.gain.setValueAtTime(0, t0); dg.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.14 + 0.1 * v, t0 + 0.4); dg.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, end);
  drone.connect(dg).connect(filter); drone.start(t0); drone.stop(end + 0.05);
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const f = scaleFreq(step + pattern[i]), start = t0 + i * gap, dur = gap * 1.8;
    const layers = v > 0.6 ? [1, 1.004] : [1];
    layers.forEach(mult => {
      const o = ac.createOscillator(), g = ac.createGain();
      o.type = wave; o.frequency.value = f * mult;
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0, start); g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.34 / layers.length, start + 0.03); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, start + dur);
      o.connect(g).connect(filter); o.start(start); o.stop(start + dur + 0.05);
    });
  }
  const pitch = v < 0.33 ? "low" : v < 0.66 ? "middle" : "high";
  const tempo = v < 0.33 ? "slow" : v < 0.66 ? "steady" : "lively";
  if (state.age === "child") return "Listen: " + count + " " + pitch + " notes, " + (v > 0.6 ? "happy and bouncy!" : v < 0.25 ? "slow and sleepy." : "calm and cheerful.");
  if (state.age === "adult") return `Sound: ${count} notes from ${scaleFreq(step).toFixed(0)} Hz, ${gap.toFixed(2)} s apart, ${wave} wave, low-pass ${(600 + v * 3600).toFixed(0)} Hz${v > 0.6 ? ", detuned doubling" : ""}.`;
  return `Sound: ${count} notes, ${pitch} pitch, ${tempo} tempo, ${v > 0.6 ? "warm and layered" : v < 0.25 ? "dry and muted" : "clear"} tone.`;
}
function demo(value) { const d = playNDVI(value); toUserLang(d).then(s => announce(s, false)); }

/* ============================================================
   VOICE GUIDE: speech recognition + speech output
   Works without a mouse or screen: press V, or Tab to the
   Voice guide button, then talk.
   ============================================================ */
const SR = window.SpeechRecognition || window.webkitSpeechRecognition;
let recog = null, listening = false, speaking = false, greeted = false;

/* ---------- live captions ---------- */
const esc = s => String(s).replace(/[&<>]/g, c => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;" }[c]));
function captionBox() {
  const b = document.getElementById("voiceBubble");
  if (!b.querySelector(".cap-guide")) b.innerHTML = '<div class="cap-you"></div><div class="cap-guide"></div>';
  return b;
}
function showCaptions(hold) {
  const b = captionBox(); b.classList.add("show");
  clearTimeout(showCaptions.t);
  if (!hold && !listening) showCaptions.t = setTimeout(() => b.classList.remove("show"), 6000);
}
function captionYou(text, interim) {
  const b = captionBox();
  b.querySelector(".cap-you").innerHTML = text ? "<b>You:</b> " + esc(text) + (interim ? ' <span class="cap-dots">…</span>' : "") : "";
  showCaptions(true);
}
function captionGuide(words, current) {
  const el = captionBox().querySelector(".cap-guide");
  el.innerHTML = "<b>Guide:</b> " + words.map((w, i) => '<span class="w' + (i === current ? " now" : i < current ? " said" : "") + '">' + esc(w) + "</span>").join(" ");
  showCaptions(speaking);
}
function bubble(html) { captionBox().querySelector(".cap-guide").innerHTML = html; showCaptions(); }
function announce(text, speakIt = true) {
  document.getElementById("live").textContent = text;
  state.lastSpoken = text;
  captionGuide(text.split(/\s+/), -1);
  if (speakIt) speakText(text);
}
function pickVoice(langTag) {
  const voices = speechSynthesis.getVoices();
  const base = langTag.split("-")[0];
  return voices.find(v => v.lang === langTag && /google|natural|online/i.test(v.name)) || voices.find(v => v.lang === langTag) || voices.find(v => v.lang && v.lang.startsWith(base)) || null;
}
/* Speak sentence by sentence: the first words start at once and the subtitles follow each word as it is spoken.
   Uses a device voice for the chosen language; if the device has none, plays Google's online voice for that language.
   Cinyanja, Ichibemba and Silozi have no voice anywhere yet, so they are read with a Swahili voice, which shares most of their sounds. */
let cloudAudio = null, cloudToken = 0;
function stopSpeech() { cloudToken++; if (cloudAudio) { try { cloudAudio.pause(); } catch (e) {} cloudAudio = null; } if ("speechSynthesis" in window) speechSynthesis.cancel(); }
function speechDone(words) { speaking = false; captionGuide(words, words.length); if (listening) startRecog(); else showCaptions(); }
function chunkText(text, max) {
  const parts = text.match(/[^.!?。！？،؟]+[.!?。！？،؟]*\s*/g) || [text], out = [];
  parts.forEach(p => {
    p = p.trim(); if (!p) return;
    while (p.length > max) { let cut = p.lastIndexOf(" ", max); if (cut < max * 0.5) cut = max; out.push(p.slice(0, cut)); p = p.slice(cut).trim(); }
    if (p) out.push(p);
  });
  return out;
}
function speakCloud(text, words, L) {
  const chunks = chunkText(text, 180), my = ++cloudToken;
  let i = 0, offset = 0;
  const next = () => {
    if (my !== cloudToken) return;
    if (i >= chunks.length) return speechDone(words);
    const c = chunks[i++], base = offset; offset += c.split(/\s+/).length;
    const a = new Audio("https://translate.google.com/translate_tts?ie=UTF-8&client=tw-ob&tl=" + encodeURIComponent(L.tts) + "&q=" + encodeURIComponent(c));
    a.playbackRate = state.age === "child" ? 0.98 : 1.08;
    cloudAudio = a;
    a.onplay = () => captionGuide(words, base);
    a.onended = next;
    a.onerror = () => { if (my !== cloudToken) return; cloudToken++; speakDevice(chunks.slice(i - 1).join(" "), words, L, null, base); };
    a.play().catch(a.onerror);
  };
  next();
}
function speakDevice(text, words, L, v, startOffset) {
  if (!("speechSynthesis" in window)) return speechDone(words);
  const tag = L.voice || L.speech;
  const sentences = text.match(/[^.!?。！？]+[.!?。！？]*\s*/g) || [text];
  let offset = startOffset || 0;
  sentences.forEach((sent, si) => {
    const u = new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(sent);
    if (v) { u.voice = v; u.lang = v.lang; } else u.lang = tag;
    u.rate = state.age === "child" ? 0.98 : 1.12;
    const base = offset; offset += sent.trim().split(/\s+/).length;
    u.onstart = () => captionGuide(words, base);
    u.onboundary = ev => { if (ev.name && ev.name !== "word") return; const idx = sent.slice(0, ev.charIndex).trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length; captionGuide(words, base + idx); };
    if (si === sentences.length - 1) u.onend = u.onerror = () => speechDone(words);
    speechSynthesis.speak(u);
  });
}
function speakText(text) {
  stopSpeech();
  const words = text.split(/\s+/), L = langInfo();
  const v = "speechSynthesis" in window ? pickVoice(L.voice || L.speech) : null;
  speaking = true;
  if (recog && listening) try { recog.abort(); } catch (e) {}
  if (v || !L.tts) speakDevice(text, words, L, v);
  else speakCloud(text, words, L);
}
function interrupt() { if (speaking) { stopSpeech(); speaking = false; if (listening) startRecog(); } }
/* Reply: English source, spoken and shown in the chosen language. */
async function say(englishText) { announce(state.lang === "en" ? englishText : await toUserLang(englishText)); }
async function note(englishText) { announce(state.lang === "en" ? englishText : await toUserLang(englishText), false); }

/* ---------- real-time recognition ---------- */
let handledUpTo = -1, interimTimer = null, pendingIdx = -1, pendingText = "";
function startRecog() {
  if (!recog || speaking) return;
  try { recog.start(); } catch (e) { /* already running */ }
}
function runCommand(idx, text) {
  if (idx <= handledUpTo || !text.trim()) return;
  handledUpTo = idx;
  captionYou(text, false);
  handleCommand(text);
}
function setupRecognition() {
  if (!SR) return;
  recog = new SR();
  recog.lang = langInfo().speech; recog.interimResults = true; recog.maxAlternatives = 1; recog.continuous = true;
  recog.onstart = () => { handledUpTo = -1; };
  recog.onresult = e => {
    for (let i = e.resultIndex; i < e.results.length; i++) {
      const text = e.results[i][0].transcript;
      if (e.results[i].isFinal) { clearTimeout(interimTimer); runCommand(i, text); }
      else {
        captionYou(text, true);
        /* If you stop talking, act after a short pause instead of waiting for the browser to finalise. */
        pendingIdx = i; pendingText = text;
        clearTimeout(interimTimer);
        interimTimer = setTimeout(() => runCommand(pendingIdx, pendingText), 650);
      }
    }
  };
  recog.onspeechstart = () => interrupt();
  recog.onend = () => { if (listening && !speaking) setTimeout(startRecog, 30); };
  recog.onerror = e => {
    const msg = {
      "not-allowed": "The browser blocked the microphone. Click the lock or microphone icon in the address bar, allow the microphone, then press V again.",
      "service-not-allowed": "This browser won't run speech recognition here. Open the page over https or localhost in Chrome or Edge, or type your command in the box at the top.",
      "audio-capture": "I can't find a microphone. Check one is plugged in and not used by another app.",
      "network": "Speech recognition needs the internet, because Chrome and Edge send audio to their speech service. Check your connection, or type your command in the box at the top."
    }[e.error];
    if (msg) { setListening(false); voiceTrouble(msg); }
  };
}
function voiceTrouble(msg) {
  say(msg);
  document.getElementById("cmdInput").focus();
}
/* Why the mic fails most often: the page must be a "secure context" (https:// or http://localhost).
   Opening the file directly (file://) or inside an app's preview frame blocks it. */
function micProblem() {
  if (!SR) return "Voice commands need Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge. Brave and Firefox don't support speech recognition. You can type your command in the box at the top instead.";
  if (!window.isSecureContext) return "The microphone only works when the page is opened over https or localhost. You can type your command in the box at the top for now.";
  if (location.protocol === "file:") return "The browser blocks the microphone for files opened from your computer. Open it over https or localhost, or type your command in the box at the top.";
  return null;
}
async function toggleListening() {
  if (listening) { setListening(false); say("Voice guide off. Press V to turn it back on."); return; }
  const problem = micProblem();
  if (problem) return voiceTrouble(problem);
  /* Ask for the microphone first, so the browser shows its permission prompt straight away. */
  if (navigator.mediaDevices && navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia) {
    try { const st = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true }); st.getTracks().forEach(tr => tr.stop()); }
    catch (err) {
      const blocked = err && (err.name === "NotAllowedError" || err.name === "SecurityError");
      return voiceTrouble(blocked
        ? (window.self !== window.top ? "This preview window isn't allowed to use the microphone. Open the page in its own browser tab over https or localhost." : "The browser blocked the microphone. Click the lock icon in the address bar, allow the microphone, then press V again.")
        : "I can't find a microphone. Check one is plugged in, then press V again.");
    }
  }
  setListening(true);
  say(greeted ? "I'm listening." : introText());
  greeted = true;
}
function introText() {
  return "Hello! I'm the voice guide for EcoSonic, made by Team Wurlitzer: exploring Earth's sounds to protect tomorrow's sights. You can say things like: I am a teen. Take me to Lusaka. What am I hearing? Show the 12-month video. Change language to Spanish. Or say help at any time.";
}

const HELP = "You can say: start. I am a child, a teen, or an adult. Go to home, jukebox, sonification, learn or about. Take me to, followed by any place on Earth. What is the NDVI here? Describe this place. Show true colour, show NDVI, or play the video. Pause, play, or close the picture. Show or hide the NDVI layer. Original globe, or realistic globe. Stop or start spinning. Zoom in or out. Play desert, grassland, woodland or rainforest. What is NDVI? Why does NDVI matter? How does the sound work? Read this page. Change language to, followed by a language. Repeat. Stop. And turn off the voice guide.";
const LANG_WORDS = { english: "en", nyanja: "ny", chinyanja: "ny", cinyanja: "ny", chewa: "ny", bemba: "bem", ichibemba: "bem", lozi: "loz", silozi: "loz", swahili: "sw", kiswahili: "sw", mandarin: "zh", chinese: "zh", "simplified chinese": "zh", "traditional chinese": "zh-TW", cantonese: "zh-TW", korean: "ko", japanese: "ja", spanish: "es", french: "fr", portuguese: "pt", german: "de", russian: "ru", arabic: "ar", hindi: "hi" };
const PRESETS = { amazon: [-3.5, -62, "Amazon Rainforest"], congo: [0.5, 23, "Congo Basin"], kafue: [-15.8, 26, "Kafue, Zambia"], sahara: [23, 12, "Sahara Desert"], "black forest": [48.5, 9, "Black Forest"] };

async function geocode(q) {
  const key = Object.keys(PRESETS).find(k => q.toLowerCase().includes(k));
  if (key) return PRESETS[key];
  try {
    const r = await fetch("https://geocoding-api.open-meteo.com/v1/search?count=1&language=en&name=" + encodeURIComponent(q));
    const j = await r.json();
    if (j.results && j.results.length) { const p = j.results[0]; return [p.latitude, p.longitude, [p.name, p.admin1, p.country].filter(Boolean).filter((x, i, a) => a.indexOf(x) === i).join(", ")]; }
  } catch (e) {}
  return null;
}
function activePanelText() {
  const screen = document.querySelector(".screen.active");
  const scope = screen.id === "mainApp" ? document.querySelector(".panel.active") : screen;
  return scope.innerText.replace(/\s+\n/g, ". ").replace(/\n+/g, ". ");
}
function describePlace() {
  if (!state.lastPlace) return "No place is selected yet. Say: take me to, and then a place name.";
  const p = state.lastPlace;
  return spokenReading(p.name, state.lastNdvi) + " " + placeInfoText(p.name, state.lastNdvi) + " " + document.getElementById("soundDesc").textContent;
}

async function handleCommand(raw) {
  let q = raw.trim();
  if (state.lang !== "en") q = await translate(q, "en", "auto");
  const s = q.toLowerCase().replace(/[.,!?¿¡]/g, "").trim();
  const has = re => re.test(s);

  if (has(/\b(help|what can i say|commands|options)\b/)) return say(HELP);
  if (has(/\b(repeat|say that again|again)\b/)) return announce(state.lastSpoken);
  if (has(/\b(turn off|stop listening|goodbye|bye|voice off)\b/)) { setListening(false); return say("Voice guide off. Press V to turn it back on."); }
  if (has(/\b(be quiet|stop talking|silence|shut up)\b/)) { interrupt(); return; }

  const lm = s.match(/(?:language|speak|switch to|change to|in)\s+(?:to\s+)?([a-z ]+)$/);
  const word = Object.keys(LANG_WORDS).sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length).find(w => new RegExp("\\b" + w + "\\b").test(s));
  if ((lm && word) || has(/\blanguage\b/)) {
    if (word) { setLanguage(LANG_WORDS[word]); return say("Language changed to " + langInfo().name + "." + (langInfo().note ? " Browsers can't recognise this language yet, so please talk to me in English. I'll answer in " + langInfo().name + " with a Swahili voice, the closest one available." : "")); }
    return say("Which language? I have English, Cinyanja, Bemba, Lozi, Swahili, Mandarin, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Spanish, French, Portuguese, German, Russian, Arabic and Hindi.");
  }

  if (has(/\b(child|kid|kids|young explorer|i am young|i'm young)\b/)) { selectAge("child", document.querySelector('[data-age="child"]')); enterApp(); return say("Okay, young explorer! The words are now bigger and simpler. Say: take me to the Amazon."); }
  if (has(/\b(teen|teenager|teen explorer)\b/)) { selectAge("teen", document.querySelector('[data-age="teen"]')); enterApp(); return say("Teen explorer mode is on. Say: take me to, and a place."); }
  if (has(/\b(adult|grown ?up|researcher|scientist)\b/)) { selectAge("adult", document.querySelector('[data-age="adult"]')); enterApp(); return say("Adult explorer mode is on, with full scientific detail."); }
  if (has(/\b(start|begin|get started)\b/) && document.getElementById("welcome").classList.contains("active")) { showAge(); return say("Who is exploring today? Say child, teen, or adult."); }
  if (has(/\b(continue)\b/) && state.age) { enterApp(); return say("Welcome. You're on the home page."); }

  const place = s.match(/(?:take me to|go to|fly to|show me|travel to|visit|zoom to|find|tell me about|how green is|what(?:'s| is) the ndvi (?:of|in|at)|ndvi (?:of|in|at)|what about|listen to)\s+(?:the\s+)?(.+)/);
  const tabs = { home: "home", jukebox: "jukebox", globe: "jukebox", "ndvi jukebox": "jukebox", sonification: "sounds", sound: "sounds", sounds: "sounds", learn: "learn", learning: "learn", about: "about" };
  const tabWord = s.match(/(?:go to|open|show|take me to)\s+(?:the\s+)?(home|jukebox|ndvi jukebox|globe|sonification|sounds?|learn(?:ing)?|about)(?:\s+(?:page|tab|section))?$/);
  if (tabWord) { goTab(tabs[tabWord[1]]); return say("Opened " + tabWord[1] + ". " + (tabs[tabWord[1]] === "jukebox" ? "Say: take me to, and then a place." : "Say: read this page, to hear it.")); }

  if (place && !/^(it|here|this|this place|that|that place)$|video|picture|image|photo|colou?r|ndvi|layer|\bmap\b|team|wurlitzer|motto/.test(place[1])) {
    note("Finding " + place[1] + "…");
    const hit = await geocode(place[1]);
    if (!hit) return say("Sorry, I couldn't find " + place[1] + ". Try a city, country or park name.");
    const ndvi = await goTo(hit[0], hit[1], hit[2]);
    return say(spokenReading(hit[2], ndvi) + " " + placeInfoText(hit[2], ndvi) + " Say: show the video, to see it change over the year.");
  }

  if (has(/\b(where am i|describe|tell me about|what am i hearing|what is the ndvi|what's the ndvi|reading|this place|what do i see|what's in the picture|what is in the picture)\b/)) return say(describePlace());
  if (has(/\b(true colou?r|real (?:colou?r|photo|picture)|photo)\b/)) { if (!state.lastPlace) return say("Pick a place first."); popView("true"); return say("Showing the NASA true-colour satellite photo from " + trueColorDate() + ". It shows the land as your eyes would see it from space, including any clouds."); }
  if (has(/\b(video|time ?lapse|12 month|twelve month|over the year)\b/)) { if (!state.lastPlace) return say("Pick a place first."); popView("lapse"); return say("Playing 12 months of NASA vegetation maps for this place. Darker green means more plants. Say pause to stop it."); }
  if (has(/\b(show|hide|turn on|turn off)\b.*\blayer\b/)) { const on = has(/\b(show|turn on)\b/); return say(setNDVILayer(on) ? (on ? "NDVI layer on. Green areas have more plants." : "NDVI layer off.") : "Open the jukebox first; the data is still loading."); }
  if (has(/\b(ndvi (?:map|image|picture))\b/)) { if (!state.lastPlace) return say("Pick a place first."); popView("ndvi"); return say("Showing the NDVI map for this place. Darker green means denser vegetation."); }
  if (has(/\bclose\b/)) { closePop(); return say("Closed the picture."); }
  if (has(/\bpause\b/)) { if (pop.view === "lapse") setLapsePlaying(false); return say("Paused."); }
  if (has(/\b(play|resume)\b/) && !has(/\b(desert|grassland|woodland|rainforest|forest)\b/)) { if (pop.view === "lapse") { setLapsePlaying(true); return say("Playing."); } if (state.lastNdvi !== undefined) { playNDVI(state.lastNdvi); return; } return say("Pick a place first."); }
  if (has(/\b(stop|mute)\b.*\b(spin|spinning|rotating)\b/) || has(/\bstop spinning\b/)) { setSpin(false); return say("Globe stopped."); }
  if (has(/\b(original|classic|old|first)\b.*\bglobe\b/) || has(/\bglobe\b.*\b(original|classic)\b/)) { setGlobeStyle("original"); return say("Switched to the original NDVI globe."); }
  if (has(/\b(realistic|real|new)\b.*\bglobe\b/) || has(/\bglobe\b.*\brealistic\b/)) { setGlobeStyle("realistic"); return say("Switched to the realistic globe, with clouds and ocean glint."); }
  if (has(/\b(spin|rotate)\b/)) { setSpin(true); return say("Globe spinning."); }
  if (has(/\bzoom in\b/) && globe) { const p = globe.pointOfView(); globe.pointOfView({ ...p, altitude: Math.max(0.4, p.altitude * 0.6) }, 800); return say("Zoomed in."); }
  if (has(/\bzoom out\b/) && globe) { const p = globe.pointOfView(); globe.pointOfView({ ...p, altitude: Math.min(4, p.altitude * 1.6) }, 800); return say("Zoomed out."); }
  const demoMatch = s.match(/\b(desert|grassland|woodland|rainforest)\b/);
  if (demoMatch && has(/\b(play|hear|sound)\b/)) { const v = { desert: 0.05, grassland: 0.3, woodland: 0.55, rainforest: 0.85 }[demoMatch[1]]; playNDVI(v); return; }
  if (has(/\bstop\b/)) { stopSound(); interrupt(); return; }
  if (has(/\b(sdg|sustainable development|global goals?)\b/)) return say(longText("sdgD"));
  if (has(/\b(play|watch|show)( me)? (a |the )?(video|clip)\b/) && pop.name && PLACE_VIDEO[pop.name]) { if (document.getElementById("popVid").hidden) togglePopVideo(); return say("Playing a video about " + pop.name + "."); }
  if (has(/\b(why (does )?(ndvi|it|greenness) matter|why is ndvi (useful|important)|relevance|community impact|what is ndvi used for)\b/)) return say(longText("relIntro") + " " + longText("relBody") + " " + longText("commD"));
  if (has(/\b(what is ndvi|what's ndvi|explain ndvi|what does ndvi mean)\b/)) return say(longText("learnIntro") + " " + longText("learnBody"));
  if (has(/\b(how does the (?:sound|music) work|sonification|how does it sound)\b/)) return say(longText("sonD") + " " + longText("pitchD") + " " + longText("densD") + " " + longText("toneD"));
  if (has(/\b(read (?:this |the )?page|read it|read everything)\b/)) return announce(activePanelText());
  if (has(/\b(who made|who built|team|wurlitzer|motto|who are you)\b/)) return say("EcoSonic was made by Team Wurlitzer for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. Our motto is: Exploring Earth's Sounds to Protect Tomorrow's Sights.");
  if (has(/\b(data|source|where does the data come from)\b/)) return say("The vegetation data comes from NASA's MODIS sensor on the Terra satellite, through NASA GIBS. The pictures are NASA true-colour and NDVI images.");

  say("Sorry, I didn't catch that. Say help to hear what I can do.");
}

/* Keyboard: V toggles the voice guide, Escape stops sound and speech. */
document.addEventListener("keydown", e => {
  const typing = /input|select|textarea/i.test(e.target.tagName);
  if (!typing && (e.key === "v" || e.key === "V") && !e.ctrlKey && !e.metaKey && !e.altKey) { e.preventDefault(); toggleListening(); }
  if (speaking && e.key !== "v" && e.key !== "V" && e.key !== "Tab") interrupt();
  if (e.key === "Escape") { stopSound(); interrupt(); closePop(); }
});

/* ============================================================
   START
   ============================================================ */
window.addEventListener("load", () => {
  learnVideo("rxOMhQwApMc", null, false);
  initLanguageMenu();
  setupRecognition();
  applyLanguage();
  initWelcomeGlobe();
  document.getElementById("cmdForm").addEventListener("submit", ev => {
    ev.preventDefault();
    const inp = document.getElementById("cmdInput"), text = inp.value.trim();
    if (!text) return;
    captionYou(text, false); inp.value = ""; handleCommand(text);
  });
  setGlobeStyle(globeStyle);
  if ("speechSynthesis" in window) speechSynthesis.getVoices();
});

</script>
</body>
</html>
